title: Configuration document
description: The versioned record behind the Admin tab, one per environment: where to look (watches and their subfolder patterns), when a run starts (intake timing), where deliverables go, and per-engagement overrides. Validated on every write; every write appends to the Config Change Log. Configuration writes the engagement record and never reaches into a run - there is no field here a guard reads. 1.1.0 (P24) adds what the Admin tab edits beyond watches: delivery destinations with their adapter and credential, the model bound to each scope layer, the credentials the environment expects (name and expiry - never a value), and per-engagement review level and engagement profile.

watches.description: Places to look. A bound watch names one engagement and infers nothing; a pattern watch covers a parent client folder and maps subfolders to engagements through the roster. No two watches may claim the same path.

root.description: A prefix relative to the storage port's root, never an absolute path. Empty means the port root itself.

engagement_id.description: Bound watches only: the one engagement this folder belongs to.

depth.description: Pattern watches only: how many path segments under the root identify an engagement folder (<Client>/<Year Engagement> is 2).

document_type_conventions.x-open-by-design: Keyed by intake document type id, whose vocabulary is the Contract Registry's intake_document_types and is versioned there, not here. Every key is checked against that vocabulary when the config is written.

additionalProperties.description: Filename tokens (case-insensitive) that bind an arriving file to this type. A filename matching none is held, never guessed.

adapter.description: Which Delivery Port adapter serves this destination. Local through P24.

credential.description: The name of the credential the adapter reads, from the Secrets Port. A name, never a value.

engagements.x-open-by-design: Keyed by engagement id; the engagements are the roster's, not this document's. Each value may only tighten what the environment sets.

review_level.description: An admin may raise this and never lower it below what the engagement started at.

profile.description: The engagement profile (engagement_profile@1.0.0), validated against that contract on every write. Configuration writes the engagement record; three skills read it as a required input (finding F1).
profile.x-open-by-design: Its shape is engagement_profile@1.0.0, pinned and validated separately so the profile contract can version on its own.

model_bindings.description: Which Excel model each scope layer builds into, resolved through the same five-layer walk as the skills - deepest binding wins, a layer bound to nothing falls through. Written once at the shallowest layer where it is true.

file.description: Null declares the layer with nothing bound: visible, and falls through.

credentials.description: The credentials this environment expects to find in the Secrets Port: a name, what it is for, and when it expires. Presence is checked through the port; the value never appears here or anywhere the admin can read.
